News | November 19, 2026


## Northwest Bank Celebrates Grand Opening of Bethel Road Financial Center in Columbus


---


**


**


*Northwest Bank leaders and community representatives cut the ribbon for the grand opening of the financial center located at 1340 Bethel Road in Columbus, Ohio, on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026. Pictured left to right: Kameron Lowe, Financial Center Manager, Northwest Bank; Christine Boucher, Director, Columbus Region Logistics Council, Columbus Chamber; Devin Teles-Cygnar, Chief Marketing and Communications Officer, Northwest Bank; Jennifer Gibson, Regional President Executive Director of Retail Banking, Northwest Bank; Dr. Frederic Bertley, CEO and President, COSI; and Anthony Chouiery, Area Manager, Northwest Bank*


**


### The remodeled space brings a personal, relationship-focused banking experience to northwest Columbus.


**Columbus, Ohio (Nov. 19, 2026)** — Northwest Bank leaders, local community partners and civic leaders celebrated the grand opening of the bank’s new financial center at 1340 Bethel Road in Columbus. The location is Northwest’s third to open in Central Ohio this year and reflects the bank’s continued investment in the market.


The Bethel Road financial center supports Northwest's relationship-focused approach to banking. Designed with a modern, open-concept layout, the financial center creates a welcoming environment that supports a more personalized, relationship-focused banking experience. From its living room-style meeting spaces, designed for meaningful financial conversations, to its convenient self-service banking options, the financial center was built to help customers bank in a way that feels both personal and accessible. With each new financial center, Northwest’s team is responding to customer and banker feedback to make the environment even more inviting. Enhancements in this financial center include a curved teller pod that provides greater privacy while supporting more natural interactions between customers and bankers.


“As we expand our presence in Columbus, we're also continuing to evolve how we design each financial center to match how we know our customers want to engage with a banker in person,” said Urich Bowers, chief consumer banking and strategy officer for Northwest Bank. “Any change that we make is focused on improving the customer’s experience and creating ways to make people feel welcomed from the moment they walk through our doors to when they leave." During the ribbon-cutting ceremony, Northwest announced a new partnership with COSI dedicated to teaching financial literacy to students and families across Central Ohio. As part of the partnership, Northwest and COSI will host hands-on learning events in five communities. Children will learn about budgeting and risk management and be introduced to careers in banking. The first event happened at Ridgeview Middle School, near the Bethel Road financial center.


Northwest will open another financial center in Gahanna in December, followed by a Westerville location in 2027. Full location details are available at[Northwest.com/Columbus.](https://www.northwest.bank/link/2c75437060bb4648b8fcce9626c12b5b.aspx)


### About Northwest Bancshares, Inc.


Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, Northwest Bancshares, Inc. is the bank holding company of Northwest Bank. Founded in 1896, Northwest Bank is a full-service financial institution offering a complete range of business and personal banking products, as well as employee benefits and wealth management services. Northwest operates 154 full-service financial centers and 11 drive-up locations across Pennsylvania, New York, Ohio and Indiana, and provides customers with fee-free access to more than 55,000 ATMs. Northwest Bancshares, Inc.’s common stock is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market (NWBI)
